description: Persistence foundation: exact-pinned new deps, M4 settings, Strands session managers (file locally, S3 when configured) wired into the coordinator with a unique session id, and a DynamoDB AssessmentStore (moto-tested) selected by config with the JSON store as default. Plan items 1-3 and decisions D-M4-5, D-M4-6, D-M4-10 in d:/github work/SDK workshop/.agents/tasks/heatwise-m4/plan.md. First feature; FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: pyproject.toml: add `mangum==0.22.0` to [project].dependencies, `moto==5.2.5` to the dev extra, new extra `agentcore = ["bedrock-agentcore==1.25.2"]`. Install with `uv pip install --python .venv\Scripts\python.exe mangum==0.22.0 moto==5.2.5 bedrock-agentcore==1.25.2` (cwd heatwise-ai). If moto lacks a backend module at import, use `moto[dynamodb,s3]==5.2.5`. Record the resolved transitive versions in findings.

backend/config.py: add `assessment_store: Literal['json','dynamodb']='json'`, `assessments_table_name: str|None=None`, `job_store: Literal['memory','dynamodb']='memory'`, `jobs_table_name: str|None=None`, `job_dispatch: Literal['thread','lambda']='thread'`, `worker_function_name: str|None=None`, `job_ttl_days: int=Field(7, ge=1, le=90)`, `job_stale_after_seconds: int=Field(420, ge=60, le=3600)`, `session_storage: Literal['file','s3','none']='file'`, `session_dir: str='.data/sessions'`, `session_bucket: str|None=None`, `session_prefix: str='sessions'`. Add a commented 'Milestone 4' block to .env.example with these names and defaults.

backend/tests/conftest.py `_isolate_settings_env`: for non-live tests, after deleting env vars, `monkeypatch.setenv('SESSION_DIR', str(request.getfixturevalue('tmp_path') / 'sessions'))` so no test writes heatwise-ai/.data/sessions.

New backend/session/sessions.py: `build_session_manager(settings, session_id) -> SessionManager | None`: 'none' -> None; 'file' -> `FileSessionManager(session_id=session_id, storage_dir=settings.session_dir)`; 's3' -> ValueError if no session_bucket, else `S3SessionManager(session_id=session_id, bucket=settings.session_bucket, prefix=settings.session_prefix, region_name=settings.aws_region)`. Module docstring states what a session holds (coordinator conversation only: place, community-level indicators, compact step summaries; no raw weather payloads, no personal data).

backend/agents/coordinator.py: `run(self, location, profile=None, forecast_days=3, session_id: str | None = None)`; `_build_agent(session_id=None)` adds `agent_id=AGENT_NAME` and `session_manager=build_session_manager(self.settings, session_id) if session_id else None` to the Agent(...) call. Keep everything else unchanged.
backend/cli.py: `assess --session-id` (default None, help: continue a stored coordinator conversation) passed as `session_id=` to `coordinator.run`.

New backend/tests/aws_fixtures.py: pytest fixtures `aws_credentials` (monkeypatch AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY/AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=testing, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1) and `aws` (`with moto.mock_aws(): yield`), plus helpers `create_assessments_table(client, name)`, `create_jobs_table(client, name)` (used by FEAT-002 too) and `create_bucket(name)` built from backend/session/dynamodb_schema.py. Import the fixtures in test modules (or register via conftest `pytest_plugins`).

New backend/tests/test_sessions.py: selection (file -> FileSessionManager writing under the tmp SESSION_DIR; none -> None; s3 without bucket -> ValueError; s3 with a moto bucket -> S3SessionManager). Continuity with file storage: two runs of `test_coordinator.build(settings, calls(*DELEGATIONS, 'finalize_report'))[0].run('Wardha', PROFILE, 3, session_id=sid)` (fresh coordinator each time) -> `FileSessionManager(sid, storage_dir).list_messages(sid, 'coordinator')` grows after the second run and the first message is the first run's prompt; another id starts empty; no session id -> SESSION_DIR stays empty; coordinator messages contain no get_weather/get_forecast toolUse (weather payloads stay in specialists). One S3 continuity case under moto (objects under `sessions/session_<sid>/agents/agent_coordinator/messages/`).

New backend/session/dynamodb_schema.py (constants only, no boto3 import): ASSESSMENTS_PK='report_id', BY_LOCATION_INDEX='by_location' (PK 'location_key', SK 'created_at'), BY_CREATED_INDEX='by_created' (PK 'entity', SK 'created_at'), ENTITY='assessment', ATTR_REQUEST='request_json', ATTR_REPORT='report_json', ATTR_DURATION='duration_ms'; JOBS_PK='job_id', PENDING_INDEX='pending' (PK 'pending_pk', SK 'created_at'), PENDING_VALUE='pending', TTL_ATTR='expires_at'; MAX_ITEM_BYTES=380_000; `ts(dt) -> str` = UTC `%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ`. The CDK app (FEAT-003) imports this module.

New backend/session/dynamodb_store.py `DynamoDbAssessmentStore(AssessmentStore)` with `__init__(table_name, client=None, region_name=None)` (boto3 low-level client 'dynamodb'): save (put_item with report_id, entity, created_at=ts(), location_key=summaries.location_key(report), request_json, report_json, duration_ms as string; ValueError for non-32-hex ids and for items > MAX_ITEM_BYTES), get (None for bad ids or missing), all (paginated query on by_created, ScanIndexForward=False), list(limit, offset) (query newest first, slice), count (Select=COUNT paginated), history_for_location(location_key, limit=20) (query by_location newest first).

backend/session/store.py: add concrete `history_for_location(self, location_key, limit=20)` to AssessmentStore that filters `self.all()` by `summaries.location_key` (import inside the method to avoid a cycle). New backend/session/factory.py `build_assessment_store(settings)`: json -> JsonFileAssessmentStore(settings.assessment_store_dir); dynamodb -> ValueError if no assessments_table_name, else DynamoDbAssessmentStore(name, region_name=settings.aws_region). backend/api/app.py: `store = store or build_assessment_store(settings)`.

New backend/tests/test_dynamodb_store.py (moto): round trip equality for complete and needs_human_review records (reuse `test_store.record` and the `reports` fixture pattern), newest-first list/offset/count, history_for_location order and key isolation (JSON store gives the same result), bad id -> None, item attributes are exactly {report_id, entity, created_at, location_key, request_json, report_json, duration_ms}, oversized item -> ValueError, history_items/compute_metrics over DynamoDB all() equal the JSON store's for the same records, factory selection + missing table name error.
acceptance_criteria: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` passes: 223 existing tests plus the new session and DynamoDB store tests, 4 deselected, offline (moto only).
With default settings the app still uses JsonFileAssessmentStore and the request keys stored stay {place, forecast_days, profile}.
A coordinator run with session_id persists the coordinator conversation via FileSessionManager and a second run with the same id restores it; S3SessionManager is selected when SESSION_STORAGE=s3.
verification: cd d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest backend/tests/test_sessions.py backend/tests/test_dynamodb_store.py backend/tests/test_store.py backend/tests/test_coordinator.py backend/tests/test_cli.py backend/tests/test_api.py -q
cd d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q  (expect 223 + new passed, 4 deselected)
Get-ChildItem d:\github work\SDK workshop\heatwise-ai\.data -Directory  (no new 'sessions' dir created by the tests)
findings: Installed (uv, exit 0): mangum==0.22.0, moto==5.2.5 (plain moto works, no [dynamodb,s3] extra needed), bedrock-agentcore==1.25.2; new transitive: requests==2.34.2, responses==0.26.3, werkzeug==3.1.9, xmltodict==1.0.4, websockets==17.4, charset-normalizer==3.5.2, markupsafe==3.0.4 (boto3/botocore stay 1.43.123). pyproject: mangum in dependencies, moto in dev extra, new extra agentcore. Settings: assessment_store, assessments_table_name, job_store, jobs_table_name, job_dispatch, worker_function_name, job_ttl_days, job_stale_after_seconds, session_storage, session_dir, session_bucket, session_prefix (+ .env.example 'Milestone 4' block). conftest sets SESSION_DIR=<tmp_path>/sessions for non-live tests. New modules: backend/session/sessions.py build_session_manager(settings, session_id); backend/session/dynamodb_schema.py constants ASSESSMENTS_PK, BY_LOCATION_INDEX, BY_LOCATION_PK='location_key', BY_CREATED_INDEX, BY_CREATED_PK='entity', CREATED_AT='created_at', ENTITY, ATTR_REQUEST/ATTR_REPORT/ATTR_DURATION, JOBS_PK, PENDING_INDEX, PENDING_PK='pending_pk', PENDING_VALUE, TTL_ATTR, MAX_ITEM_BYTES, ts(dt=None), parse_ts(str) (extra helper); backend/session/dynamodb_store.py DynamoDbAssessmentStore(table_name, client=None, region_name=None) with save/get/all/list/count/history_for_location (duration_ms stored as N, or NULL when None; GSIs must project ALL); backend/session/factory.py build_assessment_store(settings); AssessmentStore.history_for_location(location_key, limit=20) concrete default in store.py; app.py uses build_assessment_store. Coordinator: run(..., session_id=None), _build_agent(session_id=None) sets agent_id='coordinator' and session_manager. app.py run_fn does NOT pass session_id yet (FEAT-002 can). CLI: assess --session-id; passed to run() only when set (kwargs) so the existing test_cli FakeCoordinator.run without session_id keeps working. Strands note: FileSessionManager.list_messages on a session with no coordinator agent raises SessionException (not []), so tests check the session dir is absent instead. Test helpers: backend/tests/aws_fixtures.py fixtures aws_credentials, aws (mock_aws) + REGION='us-east-1', create_assessments_table(client, name), create_jobs_table(client, name) (pending GSI + TTL on expires_at), create_bucket(name); import into modules with `from backend.tests.aws_fixtures import aws, aws_credentials  # noqa: F401` (pytest_plugins is not allowed in non-root conftest). New tests: test_sessions.py 8, test_dynamodb_store.py 9. Verification: targeted run 68 passed; full `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` 240 passed, 4 deselected (223 + 17); heatwise-ai/.data contains only 'assessments' (no sessions dir). Spec docs (.kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/*) not updated in this feature; a later doc step should cover settings, session storage and the DynamoDB store.
